sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-KORL key (RB-KORL) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the Federal State Reserve Agency base Radar Station commander's office.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text: - On a desk in the "King" building (west of helicopter), first floor

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: On the second floor of the Radar Station of Reserve; the first door on the left if you walk down the hallway after coming up the stairs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Two Drawers
- Intelligence folder spawns on desk and on top of the two drawers.
